card.name: Linking words inside lists and thresholds
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, to, and, comma, open parenthesis) in the middle of a phrase, often after 'greater than or equal' or between paired terms like blood pressure and heart rate.

modes.label: Threshold phrasing
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'greater than or equal' before a number and unit.
modes.example: DBP greater than or equal<< to>> 100 mmHg,

modes.label: Joined paired terms
modes.description: 'and' linking two related body-function or clinical terms.
modes.example: Increase in Blood Pressure<< and>> Heart Rate: Monitor blood pressure and heart

modes.label: Range then parenthesis
modes.description: An open parenthesis after a temperature range giving the other unit.
